lessons.title: Your first battle
lessons.text:
You command the Wolverine at the bottom of the map (red team ring). The computer controls the Commando at the top (blue team ring). Faction paint may differ from team colors. Destroy the Commando to win.

Drag to pan the camera, pinch to zoom and twist with two fingers to orbit. Every turn begins with an initiative roll: the side that loses it must move first, so the winner gets to react.

lessons.title: Moving
lessons.text:
Tap your Wolverine. Highlighted hexes show where it can reach. The Walk button cycles through Walk, Run and Jump: running reaches farther but makes your own shots harder; jumping clears terrain and makes you hardest to hit.

Tap a hex to preview the path, use the Turn buttons to choose a facing, then Confirm. Your armor is thickest in front, so face the enemy.

lessons.title: Shooting
lessons.text:
Tap your Wolverine, then the enemy. Each weapon shows the number you need on two dice. It starts at your gunnery skill (4) and goes up with range, your movement, the target's movement and woods in the way.

Toggle weapons on or off and watch the heat total before you press Fire. If the enemy is out of range or out of sight, Hold Fire.

Whenever one of your 'Mechs is selected, plates float over every 'Mech it can see: name, a health bar and, for enemies, the best number you need to hit them.

lessons.title: Simultaneous fire
lessons.text: Attacks are declared one 'Mech at a time but resolve together at the end of the phase. A 'Mech destroyed this phase still gets its shots off, so there is no advantage in shooting first.

lessons.title: A hit!
lessons.text: Each hit rolls two dice for location. Damage strips armor first, then internal structure. Once structure is exposed, every new hit can also land a critical hit on equipment inside. Open the Sheet to watch the enemy's damage add up.

lessons.title: Taking damage
lessons.text: Your Wolverine was hit. Open the Sheet to see which location lost armor. Turning a damaged side away from the enemy spreads the punishment across fresh armor.

lessons.title: Punches and kicks
lessons.text: 'Mechs standing next to each other can punch, kick or push. Nobody is close enough yet, so this phase will pass on its own. Kicks hit hard but a miss makes you roll to stay standing.

lessons.title: Heat
lessons.text: Moving and firing build heat; heat sinks remove some every turn. Leftover heat slows you down and spoils your aim, and very high heat can shut the 'Mech down or cook off its ammo. Watch the heat line on the Sheet.

lessons.title: Turn two
lessons.text: Try to end your moves where the enemy's shots are hardest: farther away, behind woods or after a long move. Getting behind the enemy is worth a lot, because rear armor is thin.

lessons.title: Piloting roll
lessons.text: Big damage, a kick, a damaged gyro or leg can force a piloting roll. Fail it and the 'Mech falls: it takes damage, may hurt its pilot, and must spend movement to stand up.

lessons.title: Lesson one complete
lessons.text: Well fought. The next training game looks closer at to-hit numbers: range, movement and woods. Return to the Training screen to continue the campaign.
